notes.title: Updates and Bugfixes (v0.3.73 patch notes)
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!

We have been working on the game silently all these while and we feel bad about it. So here's our first official note!
[/p][p]Recent Updates :[/p][list][*][p]Added new scenarios[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added highlight outline when you are facing an interactable object[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We added a Level Editor feature in the game (still Work In Progress) that allowing you to create puzzles and share it with everyone[/p][/*][*][p]Improved lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Added brightness setting[/p][/*][*][p]More interactables around the world![/p][/*][*][p]Improved performance of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Improved localization[/p][/*][/list][p]
Bugfixes :[/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect sprites' sorting order[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where loading a save file and triggering an event immediately will cause dialogue window getting stuck on the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Various bugfixes[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: Added highlight outline when you are facing an interactable object
We added a Level Editor feature in the game (still Work In Progress) that allowing you to create puzzles and share it with everyone

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where loading a save file and triggering an event immediately will cause dialogue window getting stuck on the screen
